label: Bible Study
prompt: Let all your things be done with _____.
verse: Let all your things be done with charity.
note: 'Charity' is how the KJV says agape — love with its sleeves rolled up.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: When thou passest through the _____, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verse: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
note: Note the 'when,' not 'if' — floods and fire are assumed; the company is the promise.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, _____; for the LORD hath given you the city.
verse: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.
note: Seven laps, seven trumpets, and then the one-word battle plan at Jericho: 'Shout.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the _____ daily, whether those things were so.
verse: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
note: The Bereans got apostolic preaching and still checked the text daily — noble, says Luke.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with _____ which cannot be uttered.
verse: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
note: When words fail, the Spirit intercedes with 'groanings which cannot be uttered' — prayer below language.
